title: Session-agnostic progressive rollout with stochastic smoke ledger and automated bisect rollback
text:
Session-agnostic progressive rollout with stochastic smoke ledger and automated bisect rollback

description:
Problem: cross-session A/B and canary promotions are fragile when session affinity is unavailable (mobile clients, multi-proxy paths). We had repeated rollbacks in Q4 when users were sticky to old sessions and metrics lagged. This PR introduces a session-agnostic progressive rollout path that 1) removes hard dependence on session affinity for promotion decisions, 2) runs lightweight stochastic smoke tests (the 'smoke ledger') across slices, and 3) on detection of signal divergence triggers an automated bisect rollback sequence to isolate offending variant(s). Design: - Router-level tokenization: requests carry a lightweight trace token used to correlate cohort signals without enforcing session stickiness. This allows consistent cohorting across multi-proxy paths. - Smoke ledger: an append-only, time-windowed ledger of per-slice smoke observations (latency, error-rate, model-quality heuristics). Observations are probabilistic (sample ~1%) and contain compact histograms to keep cost low. - Bisect rollback: when ledger gates trip (configurable delta + p-value threshold), the rollout controller will run a staged binary-elimination across active variants using conservative traffic pulls and dry-run scoring. The controller keeps a reversible operation log and will automatically revert the fastest path that meets safety criteria. Why this is different: existing promote controllers require session adhesion or expensive full replay tests. This approach is lightweight, works under sessionless traffic, and has a deterministic rollback oracle that reduces human toil. Backward compatibility: rollout policies default to existing behavior unless a new "session_agnostic" flag is enabled on a rollout resource. Migration: we ship with a short-lived toggle (opt-in via rollout spec) and a rollout-console flag to visualize smoke ledger windows. Checklist: - [x] router token propagation and validation - [x] smoke ledger storage and compaction (time-windowed) - [x] rollout controller bisect algorithm + operation log - [x] end-to-end e2e smoke test harness - [x] console visualization panel and docs - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] rollout compatibility toggle and migration docs Notes: Linear ENG-2481 tracks product/design; SUP-1123 is a customer report that motivated the bisect automation. This description is a single continuous string and includes the full rationale, design, and deployment constraints.

commits:
feat(router): propagate session-agnostic token header across proxies
feat(ledger): compacted time-windowed smoke ledger with histogram encoder
feat(controller): bisect rollback runner with reversible op-log
test(e2e): deterministic smoke sequences for CI
docs: rollout console panel and migration guide

reviews:
Aisha Khan: Please ensure the ledger compaction guarantees bounded memory in high-QPS; the code looks good but add a benchmark. (request changes)
Jordan Patel: Added compaction microbenchmark and tuned rolling window to 5m by default. Reply: addressed.
Miguel Ortega: Reviewed bisect algorithm; small nit on op-log TTL and idempotency guards. (approved after fix)
Claire DuPont: Verified console UI and migration docs. Approved.

release_notes:
Introduces an opt-in session-agnostic progressive rollout path with a lightweight 'smoke ledger' for probabilistic smoke testing and an automated bisect rollback sequence. Default rollout behavior unchanged unless rollout.spec.session_agnostic=true. See migration guide in docs/rollouts/sessionless.md for rollout toggles and console flags.
